description: This file defines a PHP class 'MigrationHubConfigClient' for interacting with the AWS Migration Hub Config service, including method signatures for creating, deleting, describing, and getting the home region control settings.

classes.name: MigrationHubConfigClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Migration Hub Config service, extending the general AwsClient class.

methods.name: createHomeRegionControl
methods.description: Creates a control for the home region.

methods.name: createHomeRegionControlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a control for the home region.

methods.name: deleteHomeRegionControl
methods.description: Deletes the specified home region control.

methods.name: deleteHomeRegionControlAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes the specified home region control.

methods.name: describeHomeRegionControlsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously describes the home region controls.

methods.name: getHomeRegionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the home region information.
